title: Sliding-Window Min/Max
constraints: The window holds the last **8** accepted samples (`valid = 1`). After reset it is full of zeros.
`wmin` / `wmax` are the minimum and maximum over the window, registered: they reflect the window including the sample accepted at the latest edge. Without `valid`, nothing changes.
hints: Keep the window in an 8-entry shift register.
Compute min and max of the **new** window (din plus the 7 newest stored samples) with two comparator trees, and register the results.
A running max can't simply be updated incrementally: when the maximum leaves the window you must look at the others again.

examples.title: startup
examples.expected: wmin = 0 (zeros still in the window), wmax = 9

examples.title: expiry
examples.expected: wmax falls to the next largest value
